parameters.name: visnir spectrometer
parameters.abstract: Professional or citizen scientist instrument that measures how light spanning the visible (400-750 nm) and near-infrared (750-2500 nm) regions, interacts with materials to determine their composition, chemical, or physical properties.

parameters.name: chemicophysical laboratory
parameters.abstract: Hands-on scientific set of processes involving the testing, analyzing, and manipulation of for example chemicals, drugs, and biological materials using liquids

parameters.name: penetrometer
parameters.abstract: Diagnostic stick tool designed to measure physical (temperature, density, compaction, strength), chemical (moisture, salinity, pH, nutrients) or biological (respiration as CO2 or CH4, macro organisms as sound) properties of materials, most commonly soil.

parameters.name: ion selective electrode
parameters.abstract: Potentiometric analytical sensor that measures the activity or concentration of specific ions in an aqueous solution.

parameters.name: metabarcoding
parameters.abstract: RNA/DNA sequencing technique that identifies multiple species in a mixed biological sample (like soil, water, or feces) by simultaneously analyzing short, standardized DNA fragments (barcodes) from all organisms present.

parameters.name: enzymatic activity
parameters.abstract: Analytical or citizen scientist instrument designed to measure the rate at which an enzyme converts a substrate into a product, typically by detecting changes in color, light absorption, or fluorescence over time.

parameters.name: microbiometer microbial content
parameters.abstract: Toolkit or instrument that estimates the content of one or more microbial classes in a substance – most commonly soil.

parameters.name: aggregate stability
parameters.abstract: Tool, instrument, app or direct human observation that estimate the stability of aggregated substances, most commonly soil.

parameters.name: water infiltration
parameters.abstract: Professional or doi-it-yourself tool setup that measures the water infiltration capacity in a substance, most commonly soil

parameters.name: bi-pin salinity meter
parameters.abstract: Simple two pin instrument for estimating salinity in liquids using a microcontroller

parameters.name: soil cylinder
parameters.abstract: Volume exact cylinder for determing soil bulk density and volumetric water content
